description: Use this when you need an LLM completion without an account or API key: open-weight language-model inference for agents. Pass prompt or messages; optional model and max_tokens (default 1024, maximum 4096). Priced to the request (input + max_tokens at list rates, $0.002 USDC minimum, plus the BitTuitive fee max(20%, 3 sats)). Unpaid calls return an L402 invoice and an x402 quote. Same as call_routed_api(capability="ai_inference"). Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: run_ai_inference(prompt="Summarize the Lightning Network in one sentence.", max_tokens=128) Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed run_ai_inference call.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

messages.description: Chat messages with role and content.

model.description: Optional open-weight model id. Omit for the default.

prompt.description: A single user prompt (or pass messages).

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
